translations.English: Where can I try it on?

translations.Bemba: Nshikwete indalama ishinga linga ukulipilila ichi cintu

translations.English: Do you sell this in bulk?

translations.Bemba: Ni kwisa ukwaku ninina ama basi?
Indalama shaku lipila palwendo ni shinga?

translations.English: Can you show me on the map?

translations.Bemba: Bushe pali umuntu pa cipuna ichi?
Ni kwisa ninga sanga ifya kulya?

translations.English: What time does the bus leave?
